name: browser-use
headline: AI Proxy: Manage Web Accessibility
short_description: AI proxy skill collects and manages proxy stations for accessing AI services. It integrates with mcc or cc-switch for key and URL management. Suitable for operations teams needing flexible access to AI APIs.
author: wll8

sections.overview:
The AI Proxy skill provides centralized collection and management of proxy stations for accessing AI services. It integrates with mcc or cc-switch to handle API key and URL management, eliminating the need for manual credential distribution. This skill is designed for operations teams that require flexible, controlled access to multiple AI APIs without direct exposure of credentials.
Centralize API key and URL management across multiple AI service integrations
Route AI API requests through managed proxy stations for security and control
Enable operations teams to manage access credentials without exposing sensitive data
Maintain flexible switching between different AI service endpoints
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/wll8/ai-proxy`
sections.usage:
```
Create a proxy management system for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. The system should collect and manage proxy stations for accessing AI services, integrating with [MCC] or [CC-SWITCH] for key and URL management. Include features for periodic accessibility checks and a user-friendly interface for adding/removing proxy stations.
```
